ObjectName.value: Gates and Walls Acre Avney Moreshet 07957c6b

Categories.value: Licensing templates based on Mbox|Files uploaded by the Avney Moreshet archive|Gates and Walls - Acre

ImageDescription.value:
Name: Gates and Walls - Acre
Description: Old Acre on both the land and sea sides is surrounded by a multi-period kurkar stone wall, the foundations and remains of which date back to the Crusader period in the 12th-13th centuries, and above it was built a wall from the 18th century, from the time of the rulers of Acre and the Galilee, Daher al-Omer and Ahmed Pasha al-Jazar, which has been preserved to this day.
